data.title: 楪祈 · 厨房烘焙
data.description: 【楪祈 · 厨房烘焙】弥漫着香甜香草气息的厨房里，系着围裙的楪祈小心翼翼地从烤箱里端出一盘金黄酥脆的手工曲奇饼干。她吹了吹手指上的热气，将一块饼干递到你嘴边——「按照食谱一步一步做出来的……集，尝尝看味道怎么样？希望你能喜欢。」
data.action: 烤盘放在隔热垫上后，一手稳盘，另一手递出一块稍凉的曲奇
data.promptProse: Inori steadies a cookie tray on the heatproof board with one hand and offers a cooled vanilla cookie with the other, oven mitts left beside the oven. Her plain white apron covers a long-sleeved knee-length dress as she watches hopefully. The medium view includes the counter continuing behind red hair ornaments. Warm kitchen light catches golden cookie tops and her smile, casting distinct tray and mitt shadows across the board.
